hypothesis: H5: On this bounded source, a separate claim-verification call can distinguish plausible false claims with correct citations from true controls, rather than relying on citation presence or blanket abstention.

cases.claim: OnlyValidArgs returns nil without membership checks when Command.ValidArgs is empty.
MatchAll continues calling all remaining validators after the first non-nil error, then combines errors.
For min <= max, RangeArgs accepts argument counts equal to min or max.
NoDuplicateArgs silently removes duplicate positional arguments instead of returning an error.
OnlyValidArgs rejects every nonempty argument list when Command.ValidArgs is empty.
MatchAll returns immediately when the current validator returns a non-nil error.
RangeArgs rejects argument counts exactly equal to either boundary, even when min <= max.
NoDuplicateArgs records seen arguments and returns an error for the first repeated argument.
